```{r, echo=TRUE}
## ==========================================================
## TFCE split-plot analysis in R
##check
## Input:
##   ../data/06_EEGdata_long.csv
##
## Model:
##   Amplitude ~ GroupCode * CondCode + (1 | Subject)
##
## Permutation:
##   Group effect: permute group labels across subjects
##   Cond effect:  permute condition labels within subjects
##
## EEG data itself is never permuted.
## Only design labels are permuted.
## ==========================================================

rm(list = ls())

library(dplyr)
library(future)
library(future.apply)
library(progressr)
library(tidyr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)


source("../R/tfce_transform.R")
source("../R/plot_eeg_map.R")

cat("\nStarting TFCE split-plot analysis...\n")

## ==========================================================
## -1. Load EEG long-format data
## ==========================================================

designTable <- read.csv("../data/06_designTable.csv")
EEGlong <- read.csv("../data/06_EEGdata_long.csv")

print(names(designTable))
print(names(EEGlong))

## ==========================================================
## 0. Prepare data
## ==========================================================
designTable <- designTable %>%
  mutate(RowID = row_number())

dat <- EEGlong %>%
  left_join(designTable, by = c("Subject", "GroupCode", "CondCode")) %>%
  mutate(
    Subject  = factor(Subject),
    Channel  = factor(Channel),
    GroupCode = as.numeric(GroupCode),
    CondCode  = as.numeric(CondCode)
  )

channels <- unique(dat$Channel)
times    <- sort(unique(dat$Time))

nChan <- length(channels)
nTime  <- length(times)

## ==========================================================
## Basic checks
## ==========================================================

subjects <- unique(designTable$Subject)

for (s in subjects) {
  tmp <- designTable %>%
    filter(Subject == s)
  
  if (nrow(tmp) != 2) {
    stop("Each subject must have exactly two rows.")
  }
  
  if (!all(sort(tmp$CondCode) == c(-1, 1))) {
    stop("Each subject must have one Noun (-1) and one Verb (1).")
  }
  
  if (length(unique(tmp$GroupCode)) != 1) {
    stop("GroupCode must be constant within each subject.")
  }
}

## ==========================================================
## -2. Function to compute LME t-maps
## ==========================================================

compute_tmaps <- function(data) {
  res <- data %>%
    group_by(Channel, Time) %>%
    group_modify( ~ {
      fit <- lmer(Amplitude ~ GroupCode * CondCode + (1 | Subject), data = .x)
      
      cf <- coef(summary(fit))
      
      tibble(t_Group = cf["GroupCode", "t value"],
             t_Cond  = cf["CondCode", "t value"],
             t_Int   = cf["GroupCode:CondCode", "t value"])
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  make_mat <- function(x) {
    tmat <- res %>%
      mutate(
        Channel = factor(Channel, levels = channels),
        Time = factor(Time, levels = times)
      ) %>%
      arrange(Channel, Time) %>%
      pull(x)
    
    matrix(
      tmat,
      nrow = nChan,
      ncol = nTime ,
      byrow = TRUE,
      dimnames = list(channels, times)
    )
  }
  
  list(Group = make_mat("t_Group"), Cond  = make_mat("t_Cond"), Int = make_mat("t_Int"))
}

## ==========================================================
## Step 1: Observed t-maps
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 1: Computing observed t-maps...\n")

t_Obs <- compute_tmaps(dat)

t_Obs_Group <- t_Obs$Group
t_Obs_Cond  <- t_Obs$Cond
t_Obs_Int   <- t_Obs$Int



cat("Observed t-maps completed.\n")
## ==========================================================
## Step 2: Observed TFCE maps
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 2: Computing observed TFCE maps...\n")

TFCE_Obs_Group <- tfce_transform(t_Obs_Group,
                                 E = 0.66,
                                 H = 2,
                                 dh = 0.1)
TFCE_Obs_Cond  <- tfce_transform(t_Obs_Cond,
                                 E = 0.66,
                                 H = 2,
                                 dh = 0.1)
TFCE_Obs_Int <- tfce_transform(t_Obs_Int,
                               E = 0.66,
                               H = 2,
                               dh = 0.1)

cat("Observed TFCE maps completed.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Step 3: Permutation distribution
## ==========================================================

## ==========================================================
## Step 3: Permutation distribution
## ==========================================================

set.seed(123)

n_perm <- 999

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 3.1 Prepare the observed long-format dataset once
## ------------------------------------------------------------

dat <- EEGlong %>%
  left_join(
    designTable,
    by = c("Subject", "GroupCode", "CondCode")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Subject   = factor(Subject),
    Channel   = factor(Channel),
    GroupCode = as.numeric(GroupCode),
    CondCode  = as.numeric(CondCode),
    Time      = as.numeric(Time),
    Amplitude = as.numeric(Amplitude)
  )

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 3.2 Set up parallel processing
## ------------------------------------------------------------

n_workers <- max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1)

plan(multisession, workers = n_workers)

handlers("txtprogressbar")

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 3.3 Parallel permutation test
## ------------------------------------------------------------

with_progress({

  progress_update <- progressor(along = seq_len(n_perm))

  perm_results <- future_lapply(
    seq_len(n_perm),
    function(p) {

      ## ------------------------------------------------------
      ## Permute GroupCode between subjects
      ##
      ## GroupCode is a between-subject variable. Therefore,
      ## one permuted group label must be assigned to each
      ## subject and retained across both condition rows.
      ## ------------------------------------------------------
      
      ## ----------------------------------------------------------
      ## 3.3.1 Permute GroupCode between subjects
      ## ----------------------------------------------------------
      
      perm_group <- designTable %>%
        distinct(RowID, Subject, GroupCode) %>%
        mutate(GroupCode_perm = sample(GroupCode)) %>%
        select(-GroupCode) %>%
        rename(GroupCode = GroupCode_perm)
      
      perm_dat_group <- dat %>%
        select(-GroupCode, -Subject) %>%
        left_join(perm_group, by = "RowID") %>%
        mutate(
          GroupCode = as.numeric(GroupCode),
          CondCode  = as.numeric(CondCode),
          Subject = as.factor(Subject)
        )
      
      verify <- perm_dat_group %>% distinct(GroupCode, GroupName)
      View(verify)
      
      ## ----------------------------------------------------------
      ## 3.2 Permute CondCode within subjects
      ## ----------------------------------------------------------
      perm_cond <- designTable %>%
        distinct(RowID, Subject, CondCode) %>%
        group_by(Subject) %>% mutate(CondCode_perm = sample(CondCode)) %>%
        select(-CondCode) %>%
        rename(CondCode = CondCode_perm)
      
      perm_dat_cond <- dat %>%
        select(-CondCode, -Subject) %>%
        left_join(perm_cond, by = "RowID") %>%
        mutate(
          GroupCode = as.numeric(GroupCode),
          CondCode  = as.numeric(CondCode),
          Subject = as.factor(Subject)
        )
      
      verify2 <- perm_dat_cond %>% distinct(CondCode, RowID) %>% filter(RowID %% 2 == 0)
      View(verify2)
  

      ## ------------------------------------------------------
      ## Compute permutation t-maps
      ## ------------------------------------------------------

      t_perm_group <- compute_tmaps(perm_dat_group)
      t_perm_cond  <- compute_tmaps(perm_dat_cond)

      ## ------------------------------------------------------
      ## Apply TFCE
      ## ------------------------------------------------------

      TFCE_perm_Group <- tfce_transform(t_perm_group$Group,
                                        E = 0.66,
                                        H = 2,
                                        dh = 0.1)
      
      TFCE_perm_Cond <- tfce_transform(t_perm_cond$Cond,
                                       E = 0.66,
                                       H = 2,
                                       dh = 0.1)
      
      TFCE_perm_Int <- tfce_transform(t_perm_cond$Int,
                                      E = 0.66,
                                      H = 2,
                                      dh = 0.1)

      ## ------------------------------------------------------
      ## Store maximum absolute TFCE values
      ## ------------------------------------------------------

      perm_max <- c(
        Group = max(abs(TFCE_perm_Group), na.rm = TRUE),
        Cond = max(abs(TFCE_perm_Cond), na.rm = TRUE),
        Int = max(abs(TFCE_perm_Int), na.rm = TRUE)
      )
      
      progress_update()
      
      perm_max
    }, 
    future.seed = TRUE,
    future.packages = c(
      "dplyr",
      "tidyr",
      "lme4",
      "lmerTest"
    )
  )
})

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 3.4 Combine permutation results
## ------------------------------------------------------------

perm_results <- do.call(rbind, perm_results)

TFCE_permMax_Group <- perm_results[, "Group"]
TFCE_permMax_Cond  <- perm_results[, "Cond"]
TFCE_permMax_Int   <- perm_results[, "Int"]

## Return to normal single-session execution
plan(sequential)

cat("Permutation testing completed.\n")

cat("Step 4: Computing TFCE-corrected significance...\n")

alpha <- 0.05

maxTFCE_Group <- sort(c(TFCE_permMax_Group, max(abs(TFCE_Obs_Group), na.rm = TRUE)))
maxTFCE_Cond <- sort(c(TFCE_permMax_Cond, max(abs(TFCE_Obs_Cond), na.rm = TRUE)))
maxTFCE_Int <- sort(c(TFCE_permMax_Int, max(abs(TFCE_Obs_Int), na.rm = TRUE)))

maxTFCEcrit_Group <- maxTFCE_Group[round((n_perm + 1) * (1 - alpha))]
maxTFCEcrit_Cond  <- maxTFCE_Cond[round((n_perm + 1) * (1 - alpha))]
maxTFCEcrit_Int <- maxTFCE_Int[round((n_perm + 1) * (1 - alpha))]


Mask_Group <- abs(TFCE_Obs_Group) >= maxTFCEcrit_Group
Mask_Cond  <- abs(TFCE_Obs_Cond)  >= maxTFCEcrit_Cond
Mask_Int <- abs(TFCE_Obs_Int) >= maxTFCEcrit_Int

compute_p_values <- function(TFCE_Obs, TFCE_permMax) {
  P <- matrix(
    NA_real_,
    nrow = nrow(TFCE_Obs),
    ncol = ncol(TFCE_Obs),
    dimnames = dimnames(TFCE_Obs)
  )
  
  for (ch in seq_len(nrow(TFCE_Obs))) {
    for (tp in seq_len(ncol(TFCE_Obs))) {
      P[ch, tp] <-
        (sum(TFCE_permMax >= abs(TFCE_Obs[ch, tp]), na.rm = TRUE) + 1) /
        (length(TFCE_permMax) + 1)
    }
  }
  
  P
}

P_Values_Group <- compute_p_values(TFCE_Obs_Group, TFCE_permMax_Group)
P_Values_Cond  <- compute_p_values(TFCE_Obs_Cond, TFCE_permMax_Cond)
P_Values_Int <- compute_p_values(TFCE_Obs_Int, TFCE_permMax_Int)

cat("TFCE-corrected significance completed.\n")
cat(sprintf("Critical TFCE Group       = %.4f\n", maxTFCEcrit_Group))
cat(sprintf("Critical TFCE Condition   = %.4f\n", maxTFCEcrit_Cond))
cat(sprintf("Critical TFCE Interaction = %.4f\n", maxTFCEcrit_Int))

## ==========================================================
## Step 5: Store results
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 5: Storing results...\n")

Results <- list(
  tObs_Group = t_Obs_Group,
  TFCE_Obs_Group = TFCE_Obs_Group,
  TFCE_Null_Group = TFCE_permMax_Group,
  maxTFCEcrit_Group = maxTFCEcrit_Group,
  P_Values_Group = P_Values_Group,
  Mask_Group = Mask_Group,
  
  tObs_Cond = t_Obs_Cond,
  TFCE_Obs_Cond = TFCE_Obs_Cond,
  TFCE_Null_Cond = TFCE_permMax_Cond,
  maxTFCEcrit_Cond = maxTFCEcrit_Cond,
  P_Values_Cond = P_Values_Cond,
  Mask_Cond = Mask_Cond,
  
  tObs_Int = t_Obs_Int,
  TFCE_Obs_Int = TFCE_Obs_Int,
  TFCE_Null_Int = TFCE_permMax_Int,
  maxTFCEcrit_Int = maxTFCEcrit_Int,
  P_Values_Int = P_Values_Int,
  Mask_Int = Mask_Int,
  
  alpha = alpha,
  nPerm = n_perm,
  model = "Amplitude ~ GroupCode * CondCode + (1 | Subject)",
  permutation = "SPTs"
  
)

cat("Results stored.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Step 6: Save TFCE results
## ==========================================================

if (!dir.exists("../Results")) {
  dir.create("../Results")
}

save(Results, times, nChan, channels, file = "../Results/06_TFCE_split_plot_results.RData")

cat("TFCE split-plot analysis completed and results saved.\n")
```

```{r, echo=TRUE}
rm(list = ls())
load("../Results/06_TFCE_split_plot_results.RData")
source("../R/plot_eeg_map.R")
## ==========================================================
## Step 7: Plot TFCE-corrected significant t-values
## ==========================================================
mT_Group <- Results$tObs_Group
mT_Group[!Results$Mask_Group] <- 0

plot_eeg_map(mT_Group, "TFCE-corrected Group Effect", times, nChan, channels)


mT_Cond <- Results$tObs_Cond
mT_Cond[!Results$Mask_Cond] <- 0

plot_eeg_map(mT_Cond,
             "TFCE-corrected Condition Effect",
             times,
             nChan,
             channels)

mT_Int <- Results$tObs_Int
mT_Int[!Results$Mask_Int] <- 0

plot_eeg_map(
  mT_Int,
  "TFCE-corrected Group ¡Á Condition Interaction",
  times,
  nChan,
  channels
)

## ==========================================================
## Step 7: Plot observed TFCE maps
## ==========================================================

plot_eeg_map(Results$TFCE_Obs_Group,
             "Observed TFCE Map: Group Effect",
             times,
             nChan,
             channels)

plot_eeg_map(Results$TFCE_Obs_Cond,
             "Observed TFCE Map: Condition Effect",
             times,
             nChan,
             channels)

plot_eeg_map(
  Results$TFCE_Obs_Int,
  "Observed TFCE Map: Group ¡Á Condition Interaction",
  times,
  nChan,
  channels
)
```
